start.title: The Voice in the Wilderness
start.text:
John cries by the Jordan:
"Repent, the Kingdom is near."

choices.feedback: He speaks the word of God.

mock_consequence.title: Honor the Prophet
mock_consequence.text:
He is the voice prepared by God.
Lisen humbly.

turn_consequence.title: Stay at the River
turn_consequence.text:
Your hour begins here.
The Father has called you.

crowds.title: Among the People
crowds.text:
Crowds gather along the shore.
They come to be cleansed.

choices.feedback: You came to be among them.

choices.text: Walk among them as a brother
choices.feedback: You move quietly through the crowd.

apart_consequence.title: Walk With Them
apart_consequence.text:
You came to share their humanity.
Walk among them.

choices.text: Walk among them as a brother

approach.title: Toward John
approach.text:
John stands in the river.
His eyes find yours.

demand_consequence.title: Be Humble
demand_consequence.text:
You did not come to be honored.
You came to obey.

wait_consequence.title: The Hour Has Come
wait_consequence.text:
The Father waits for this moment.
Go to John.

hesitate.title: John's Hesitation
hesitate.text:
John whispers:
"I should be baptized by You."

choices.text: "Let it be so to fulfill all."

agree_consequence.title: Fulfill the Way
agree_consequence.text:
This must be done in obedience.
Speak the word.

choices.text: "Let it be so to fulfill all."

rebuke_consequence.title: Speak Gently
rebuke_consequence.text:
He is your forerunner.
Answer him with peace.

choices.text: "Let it be so to fulfill all."

baptism.title: Into the Water
baptism.text:
The cool river rises.
You bow your head.

resist_consequence.title: Surrender
resist_consequence.text:
This is the will of the Father.
Yield to the moment.

dove.title: The Heavens Open
dove.text:
The sky parts above you.
A dove descends in silence.

choices.text: Lift your eyes to the Father

hide_consequence.title: Look Up
hide_consequence.text:
You are the Beloved Son.
Receive the gift.

choices.text: Lift your eyes to the Father

boast_consequence.title: Receive in Silence
boast_consequence.text:
This moment is sacred.
Let the Spirit speak.

choices.text: Lift your eyes to the Father

voice.title: The Father's Voice
voice.text:
"This is My beloved Son,
in whom I am well pleased."
